description: One match on betrend by its URL or slug: teams, status, score, scores by period (halves, quarters, sets, innings, maps), key events such as goals, cards and substitutions, venue, competition, round and kick-off time in UTC. Includes the betrend.im match page URL.

match.description: Match URL (https://betrend.im/en/matches/<slug>) or the slug from another tool.

name: match_details

as_of.description: When betrend produced this answer, UTC ISO 8601.

detail.description: Assist, player coming on, penalty or own goal.

has_more.description: Present and true when more items exist than returned; narrow the filters.

head_to_head_url.description: betrend.im head-to-head page of the two teams.

url.description: betrend.im page URL of the team.
betrend.im page URL of the competition.
betrend.im page URL of the team.

score_text.description: Score as written on betrend; cricket shows runs, wickets and overs.

status_label.description: Short status as shown on betrend: live minute or period, FT, AET, PP and similar.

notice.description: How to narrow the request when truncated.

period.description: H1, H2, Q1, P2, S1, Inn 1, ET, OT, Pen and similar.

truncated.description: Present and true when the longest list was cut to keep the answer under 20000 bytes.

title: Match details
